name: Hedera Swiss Franc
oneLiner: HCHF is HLiquity's Swiss-franc stablecoin on Hedera, minted from overcollateralized HBAR troves via Liquity-style borrowing and Stability Pool liquidations.
collateral: HBAR locked in overcollateralized HLiquity Troves on Hedera, with a 110% minimum collateral ratio and Stability Pool liquidations
pegMechanism: Liquity-style borrowing protocol on Hedera: users mint HCHF debt against HBAR collateral, undercollateralized Troves are liquidated through the Stability Pool, and HCHF can be redeemed for HBAR collateral at face value to support the CHF peg
